canonical_statement: For every positive-dimensional finite Euclidean coordinate space, closed rectangular box [a,b], and continuously differentiable vector field with integrable coordinate divergence, the volume integral of the divergence equals the signed sum of its coordinate components over the upper and lower faces.
domain_and_universes: n : Nat; Euclidean n = Fin (n + 1) -> Real; target is Prop in Lean universe 0
ordered_binders: f' : Euclidean n -> Euclidean n ->L[Real] Euclidean n
hypotheses: f' is the Frechet derivative of f at every point of the open box
coordinateDivergence f' is integrable on Icc a b
conclusion: The restricted volume integral of coordinateDivergence f' over Icc a b equals outwardFlux a b f, the upper-face integral minus lower-face integral summed over coordinates.
scope_decision: The repository provides only a theorem-family slogan and no uniquely determined general-domain proposition. The statement gate selects the pinned mathlib module's documented classical rectangular-box formulation, without claiming a theorem for arbitrary regular regions.

killed: changed arbitrary positive dimension to three-space
changed universal boxes to an existentially selected box
excluded degenerate boxes by replacing a <= b with coordinatewise strict inequality

degenerate_cases: n = 0 represents one real coordinate. Boxes with equal endpoints in any coordinate remain in scope through a <= b; empty interiors make the derivative premise vacuous while the pinned divergence theorem handles zero-volume and cancelling-face behavior.
status_boundary: This freezes and elaborates a box-scoped exact target with one pinned direct import, checked expansion, and four structural mutations. It supplies no proof, anchor acceptance, audit completion, or theorem completion.
